name: GYKI 52895
summary: GYKI-52895 is a drug which is a 2,3-benzodiazepine derivative that also shares the 3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine pharmacophore. Unlike other similar drugs, GYKI 52895 is a selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI), which appears to have an atypical mode of action compared to other DRIs.g.g. ethylphenidate). However, dopaminergic drugs are also prone to producing emetic effects such as in the case of apomorphine.

pharmacology.text: Unlike other similar drugs, GYKI 52895 is a selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI), which appears to have an atypical mode of action compared to other DRIs.

uses.text: Egis Pharmaceuticals began clinical development of the drug in 1997 for major depressive disorder and Parkinson's disease, but it was discontinued in 2001.

fact.en: GYKI 52895 is an unusual hybrid: a 2,3-benzodiazepine like tofisopam that also carries the methylenedioxy ring pattern found in MDA, yet it acts as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor.
fact.zh: GYKI 52895 是一種罕見的混合體：它是類似 tofisopam 的 2,3-苯二氮平類，又帶有 MDA 中的亞甲二氧基環結構，作用卻是多巴胺再回收抑制劑。
